question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Appearance
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Appearance"** means the way that someone or something looks. (प्रकट होना)

 
 
• **Example: **Her sudden **appearance** at the party surprised everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Exit"** refers to a way out or the act of leaving a place. (निकास)
 
 
• **Example: **He made a quick **exit **after the meeting was over.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Appearance'** is **'Exit'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Commencement **(आरंभ): The beginning or start of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The commencement of the project was delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.
 
 
 
• **Masquerade **(छलावा): A false show or pretense.
 
 
• **Example: **She pretended to be happy, but it was all a masquerade.
 
 
 
• **Ingress** (प्रवेश): The act of entering.
 
 
• **Example:** The ingress of water into the building caused a lot of damage.
